guideContent.strategyOverview: Rakdos group slug with a true Bracket 4 combo gear. Valgavoth, Harrower of Souls commands the deck: a 4-mana Ward+flying engine that puts a +1/+1 counter on itself and draws a card the first time each opponent loses life on their own turn. In a shell wired to make every opponent bleed (Eidolon of the Great Revel, Pyrostatic Pillar, Harsh Mentor, Mogis, Underworld Dreams, Roiling Vortex), Valgavoth refuels ~3 cards per turn cycle while growing into an evasive clock that survives spot removal. The Lord of Pain backs it up from the 99 — when drawn or tutored it locks off opponent lifegain and deals each turn's first-spell mana value to a chosen player. Damage multipliers like Fiery Emancipation, Solphim, Twinflame Tyrant, and Bloodletter of Aclazotz turn those pings into lethal threats. Five tutors (Demonic Tutor, Vampiric Tutor, Grim Tutor, Diabolic Intent, Beseech the Mirror) assemble the Hidetsugu + damage-doubler combo on turn 5-6, and also reliably fetch The Lord of Pain when the lifegain lock is needed. A cheap draw-punisher cluster (Kederekt Parasite, Razorkin Needlehead, Underworld Dreams, Fate Unraveler, Sheoldred) taxes every opponent draw for asymmetric life loss that also feeds Valgavoth. Reanimate / Animate Dead recur a high-value creature from a naturally-filled graveyard. Mana Vault and Sol Ring provide the explosive turns needed to land a doubler and Hidetsugu in the same turn.

winConditions.title: Heartless Hidetsugu Lethal Activation
winConditions.description: Activate Heartless Hidetsugu to deal half each player's life total as damage. With any damage doubler (Solphim, Twinflame Tyrant, or Fiery Emancipation), the damage equals or exceeds their life total. Lethal to all opponents at even life totals. Stay at odd life to survive. Twinflame Tyrant doubles only opponent damage for a safer kill. Sim caveat: Heartless Hidetsugu's tap activation has summoning sickness, so the goldfish sim may over-credit comboLethal by one turn when both pieces are cast the same turn.

winConditions.title: Peer into the Abyss Kill
winConditions.description: Target an opponent with Peer into the Abyss to halve their life and draw half their library. Sheoldred deals 2 per card drawn, Underworld Dreams deals 1 per draw. With 20+ cards drawn, Sheoldred alone adds 40 damage on top of the life halving. Any single draw punisher alongside Peer is lethal.

winConditions.title: Repercussion Board Wipe
winConditions.description: Blasphemous Act deals 13 damage to each creature. Repercussion redirects that damage to each creature's controller. Two creatures per opponent means 26 damage each. With Fiery Emancipation tripling your damage sources, that becomes 78 per opponent. Careful positioning required since your own creatures also trigger Repercussion.

sources.name: Claude analysis

winConditions.title: Damage Multiplier Stack
winConditions.description: Stack multiple damage multipliers so that every ping becomes lethal. The Lord of Pain's 5-damage trigger becomes 10 with Solphim, 30 with Fiery Emancipation, then Wound Reflection doubles all life loss at end step. Two multipliers plus Wound Reflection turns any damage source into a kill. Even a single fetchland activation from an opponent under Ankh of Mishra cascades into massive life loss.

sources.name: Claude analysis

winConditions.title: Bolas's Citadel Life Storm
winConditions.description: Cast spells from library top by paying life instead of mana. Chain low-cost spells to deal incremental damage through punisher effects. Activate Citadel's ability to sacrifice 10 nonland permanents and deal 10 damage to each opponent. With Wound Reflection, that 10 becomes 20 at end step. Even without the activated ability, chaining 5-6 spells from library top with damage multipliers active is often lethal.

synergies.title: Valgavoth + Group-Slug Punishers
synergies.description: Valgavoth draws a card and grows the first time each opponent loses life on their own turn. The deck makes that happen automatically: Mogis and Roiling Vortex ping on upkeep, Underworld Dreams / Sheoldred punish their draw step, and Eidolon / Pyrostatic Pillar tax their spells. ~3 cards per turn cycle from the command zone, while Valgavoth's Ward—Pay 2 + flying keep it sticky and turn it into an evasive growing clock.

synergies.title: Draw Punishment Package
synergies.description: Each normal opponent draw now costs up to 7: Sheoldred 2 + Dreams 1 + Unraveler 1 + Kederekt Parasite 1 (needs a red permanent) + Razorkin Needlehead 1. Three opponents drawing 1 card each = ~21 per turn cycle before doublers; Solphim/Twinflame double the damage-based pings (Razorkin, Kederekt, Dreams, Unraveler), Wound Reflection doubles ALL life loss at end step. Because these fire on opponents' own draw steps (their turns), each one also triggers Valgavoth's draw + counter. Orcish Bowmasters adds +1 per EXTRA draw beyond the first. Peer into the Abyss turns the whole package into a one-shot kill.

With Solphim: 4 per activation.

Best targets: Heartless Hidetsugu, Solphim Mayhem Dominus, Twinflame Tyrant, Sheoldred the Apocalypse, Bloodletter of Aclazotz. Value/resilience role — no longer paired with a dedicated graveyard-filler (Entomb cut in DEC-362), so it relies on organic graveyard stocking.
